title: Rav Tuvi son of Rav Nechemyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Beitzah 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.12b.13): he had a jug of terumah wine and came before Rav Yosef, asking, “May I bring it to a Kohen today?” etc. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Tuvi son of Rav Mattenah, which Hyman prefers because, in his observation, Rav Tuvi son of Rav Nechemyah is not mentioned anywhere else.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara calls the sage Rav Tuvi son of Rav Nechemyah, as does [Heilprin’s entry for this exchange](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1589&lang=en). Rav Yosef answers him with Rav Yehudah’s ruling in Shmuel’s name. Hyman favors the Dikdukei Soferim reading “son of Rav Mattenah.” [Heilprin’s Mattenah entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1590&lang=en) lists other passages under that patronymic.
